milestone: Energy Conservation (Amendment) Act enables carbon market
detail: Legal basis for an Indian carbon credit trading scheme created.
MoP/BEE notify CCTS 2023; compliance + offset mechanisms; NSCICM constituted.
MoEFCC market-based incentive for environmental actions (distinct from CCTS).
Voluntary (offset) mechanism detailed for non-obligated entities.
GHG-intensity targets notified for obligated entities in energy-intensive sectors (incl. aluminium, cement, pulp & paper, chlor-alkali); first cycle 2025-26.
Power exchanges + registry (Grid-India) prepare for Indian Carbon Market certificate trading.
